svg.title: Exploration, a locked claim, and a fresh interval
svg.desc: Twenty candidates lead to one chosen claim, then a prespecified fresh check. Selected estimate eight SE three has an unadjusted Normal 95 percent interval 2.12 to 13.88. Fresh estimate three SE two has interval -0.92 to 6.92, crossing zero and the +2 practical threshold. The separate independent-null-test calculation is 64.15 percent, not the probability this selected claim is false.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,98%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: A selected finding needs fresh evidence
Exploration proposes a claim; a locked analysis evaluates it on new cases.
